   1 class_name SaveSystem extends System
   2 
   3 @export var runtime: Node = null
   4 
   5 func setup() -> void:
   6 	assert(is_instance_valid(runtime))
   7 
   8 func query() -> QueryBuilder:
   9 	return q.with_all([C_Session, C_Progression, C_Checkpoint]).enabled()
  10 
  11 func process(entities: Array[Entity], _components: Array, _delta: float) -> void:
  12 	for entity in entities:
  13 		if not entity.enabled:
  14 			continue
  15 		var checkpoint: C_Checkpoint = entity.get_component(C_Checkpoint)
  16 		var session: C_Session = entity.get_component(C_Session)
  17 		var progression: C_Progression = entity.get_component(C_Progression)
  18 		if not checkpoint.save_requested:
  19 			if session.save_status == "pending" and runtime.save_repository.uses_browser_storage() and runtime.save_repository.last_read_acknowledged:
  20 				session.save_status = "saved"
  21 				session.message = "已读取本浏览器检查点"
  22 			continue
  23 		checkpoint.save_requested = false
  24 		var payload: Dictionary = {"version": 1, "checkpoint_id": checkpoint.checkpoint_id, "room_id": checkpoint.room_id, "spawn_id": checkpoint.spawn_id, "moonstep": progression.moonstep, "visited_rooms": progression.visited_rooms.duplicate(), "boss_defeated": progression.boss_defeated, "ending_seen": progression.ending_seen}
  25 		var valid: Dictionary = runtime.save_repository.validate(payload, runtime.rooms, runtime.resources)
  26 		if valid.is_empty():
  27 			session.save_status = "failed"
  28 			session.message = runtime.save_repository.last_error
  29 			continue
  30 		checkpoint.payload = valid.duplicate(true)
  31 		checkpoint.valid = true
  32 		session.save_status = "pending"
  33 		if not runtime.save_repository.write_save(valid, runtime.rooms, runtime.resources):
  34 			session.save_status = "failed"
  35 			session.message = runtime.save_repository.last_error + " · 本次可从检查点重试"
  36 		elif runtime.save_repository.uses_browser_storage():
  37 			session.save_status = "saved"
  38 			session.message = "已存入本浏览器 · 请保留此站点数据"
  39 		else:
  40 			session.save_status = "saved"
  41 			session.message = "绯月消散 · 赌城的诅咒已被斩断 · 进度已保存" if session.mode == "ending" else "存档成功"
